info.title: efrpg - EntityFramework Reverse POCO Generator tool
info.description: Command-line tool for the EntityFramework Reverse POCO Code First Generator. Reads database schema and outputs it for use by the EFRPG T4 template.

options.name: --database
options.description: Database type: SqlServer, PostgreSQL, MySql, SQLite, Oracle

options.name: --secrets-stdin
options.description:
Read connection strings as XML from stdin. Preferred: unlike the options below,
the value never appears in process listings or command-line audit logs.
Format: <Secrets><Connection>..</Connection><MultiContextConnection>..</MultiContextConnection></Secrets>

options.name: --connection
options.description: Connection string. Convenient for interactive use, but VISIBLE IN PROCESS LISTINGS.

options.name: --connection-base64
options.description:
As --connection, UTF-8 base64 encoded to sidestep shell quoting. Base64 is not
encryption - this is equally visible in process listings.

options.name: --stored-procedures
options.description: Read stored procedures, table-valued and scalar-valued functions (slow on large databases)

options.name: --synonyms
options.description: Include database synonyms when reading tables, foreign keys, and stored procedures

options.name: --enums-base64
options.description: Enum specs (XML, UTF-8 base64). When set, the tool reads only enum rows. Used by the T4 template.

options.name: --multi-context
options.description: Also read multi-database-context settings from the MultiContext.* tables.

options.name: --multi-context-connection-base64
options.description: Connection string for the multi-context settings database (UTF-8 base64).

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the tool version and the wire format schema version, then exit.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this help.
Output: XML written to stdout. Errors written to stderr.
Exit codes: 0 = success, 1 = startup error, 2 = partial failure (some reads failed).
